aws.pci.apigateway.all_methods_logging.summary: Set ERROR or INFO execution logging for the reviewed REST API stage and its method overrides.
steps: Read the stage methodSettings and identify the wildcard setting and every explicit method override whose loggingLevel is OFF or unavailable.
Confirm the owner-approved logging level and review log content, access, retention, and the CloudWatch Logs role before changing settings.
Set ERROR or INFO on the stage wildcard and each affected method override, then read back GetStages and verify log delivery with an approved test request.
caveats: GetStages settings do not prove that logs reach CloudWatch; account logging permissions and delivery must be verified separately.
An absent wildcard or omitted loggingLevel in an override remains UNKNOWN because deployed-route coverage and field inheritance are unproven.
Avoid request or response data tracing unless separately approved because it may record sensitive data.

field_binding.path: id; ParentApiId; stageName; _provenance.source_operation; complete rest_api_stage scope; methodSettings['*/*'].loggingLevel; methodSettings[method override].loggingLevel

aws.pci.apigateway.all_methods_cache_enc.summary: Enable encryption for each reviewed method cache that is already approved for use.
steps: Read cacheClusterEnabled, cacheClusterStatus, and all methodSettings; identify explicitly enabled method caches with cacheDataEncrypted=false.
Confirm that caching is required for each affected method and review cached data sensitivity, TTL, cost, and operational impact with the API owner.
Enable Encrypt cache data on each approved affected method, then read back GetStages and verify cache behavior with an approved test request.
caveats: A disabled stage cache or disabled method caching is outside this encryption predicate; do not enable hourly-billed caching solely to clear the finding.
A wildcard with encryption disabled does not prove an active deployed method exists; absent route proof remains UNKNOWN unless an explicit enabled unencrypted override is present.
Changing cache encryption settings can flush or alter cache behavior; plan the change with the API owner.

field_binding.path: id; ParentApiId; stageName; _provenance.source_operation; complete rest_api_stage scope; cacheClusterEnabled; cacheClusterStatus; methodSettings['*/*'].cachingEnabled/cacheDataEncrypted; methodSettings[method override].cachingEnabled/cacheDataEncrypted
